origin.sample: HeLa, HNRNPC knockdown and control experiment
origin.source_package_license: LGPL (upstream does not specify a version; package DESCRIPTION preserved)
origin.junction_source: Unique N operations and XS strands from selected upstream TopHat2 2.0.8b alignments, shifted to local window coordinates. Observations from these reads, not independent annotations or truth.
origin.transformation: Read primary paired alignments in the pinned chr14 BAM. Keep complete pairs whose two alignments fit wholly within hg19 chr14:[102480000,102520000). Sort names lexicographically and take the first 256 pairs. Restore sequence/quality orientation using the SAM reverse flag. Write Phred+33 FASTQ. Extract matching UCSC reference bases, uppercase them and wrap at 60 bp. No read bases or numeric quality scores are modified.
limitations: Reads are recovered from TopHat2 alignments rather than copied from raw sequencer files; prior clipping, quality conversion and processing remain.
The source TopHat command uses --solexa-quals; the fixture preserves numeric qualities from that BAM and emits Phred+33.
Reads were selected for mapping to a narrow window. This cannot establish whole-genome mapping specificity or quantitative expression accuracy.
Human splice hints are derived from the same selected reads. Hint-assisted cases test port equivalence only, not an independent biological prediction.
